name: voice.elevenlabs
title: Voice (ElevenLabs)
summary: The ElevenLabs provider of voice.speak: speak lines with an ElevenLabs voice to one WAV per line (plus the original MP3), with speech-start/end times. Needs the elevenlabs_api_key secret file and network access.
description: Performs each line in `lines` with one ElevenLabs voice and writes <name>.wav plus the provider's original <name>.mp3 (pcm_* formats write only the WAV). The result has the same fields as voice.piper (voice.speak contract), plus the model, per-line request ids, the characters billed and, when ElevenLabs reports it, the credits spent. eleven_v3 performs audio tags such as [whispers], [excited] or [laughs] inside the text. Lines are spoken one at a time; requests are retried on 429, 5xx and network errors. Identical requests reuse the earlier take by default (cache "reuse") to save credits: submit with cache "off" for a new take. The API key is read from a secret file and never appears in results or logs. A text-to-speech-only key cannot list voices: voice.list with provider elevenlabs then returns a catalogue of premade voices.

voice.description: ElevenLabs voice id, for example JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb (George). voice.list with provider elevenlabs lists ids.

lines.description: The lines to speak, in order; each becomes <name>.wav. A line is a plain string (named line-001, line-002, ...) or {text, name}.

oneOf.description: A line to speak, shorthand for {"text": "<this string>"}.
A line with an explicit text and an optional output name.

text.description: What to say. eleven_v3 performs audio tags such as [whispers], [excited] or [laughs]; CAPS stress a word and "..." adds a beat.

name.description: Output file name without extension, e.g. who-0 writes who-0.wav and who-0.mp3. Unique inside one call.

model.description: ElevenLabs model id. eleven_v3 acts audio tags; eleven_multilingual_v2 is steadier; eleven_flash_v2_5 is the cheapest (about half the credits per character).

similarity.description: Similarity boost to the original voice (maps to similarity_boost).

speed.description: Speaking rate, 1 = the voice's own pace (maps to voice_settings.speed). ElevenLabs accepts 0.7 to 1.2; for more, change the tempo with audio.process.

seed.description: Seed for repeatable generation when the model supports it; the same seed is used for every line. Omit for varied takes.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code (maps to language_code), for example en. Omit to let the model detect it.

output_format.description: ElevenLabs output format: mp3_<rate>_<kbps> keeps the MP3 and decodes it to WAV; pcm_<rate> (paid tiers) writes the WAV directly. mp3_44100_128 is the best the Free tier allows.

speech_end_threshold_db.description: Level (dBFS) below which a sample counts as silence when measuring speech_start_s and speech_end_s.

model.description: The model id that was used.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the WAV files in Hz.

lines.description: One entry per line, in input order.

speech_end_s.description: Where audible speech ends (plus a 30 ms tail).

original.description: The provider's original file (<name>.mp3), or null for pcm formats.

credits.description: Credits spent, from ElevenLabs' character-cost header; null when it was not reported.

examples.title: Two lines with George on eleven_v3
Acted line, natural stability, fixed seed
